findings.title: Fixed normal critical value does not justify the claimed 95 percent small-sample threshold

citations.quote: /** Autocorrelation-adjusted sample size at the best lag. */
// 95 % critical |r| for n−2 degrees of freedom, via the t↔r identity with

findings.mechanism: effectiveN can be clamped to3. The formula always uses tCrit=1.96 and comments that it is conservative below about30; it is not conservative for a Student-t correlation threshold with df=1. The reading text presents Real/Noise and an unlikely-artefact interpretation without qualifying this approximation.
findings.sourceOnlyRepro: Logged scalar arithmetic for effectiveN3/df1: code cutoff0.8908; exact two-sided95-percent Student-t df1 critical12.706204736 gives cutoff0.9969. Coefficient0.95 clears the code cutoff but not that threshold. This confirms the small-n confidence-copy mismatch; it does not validate Bartlett assumptions, an actual dataset, peak-selection calibration or causal significance.
findings.fix: Request a narrow domain/statistical-owner decision: qualify this as an approximate screening threshold or adopt an authorized calibrated rule with covering cases. Do not silently change existing scientific outputs in a page migration.

findings.title: Accessible chart numeric columns bypass saved locale formatting

findings.sourceOnlyRepro: For de-DE, raw coefficient0.8123 reaches String(raw)="0.8123" rather than "0,8123"; sample count1441 reaches "1441" rather than "1.441". Logged source-branch and CultureInfo arithmetic only, not browser or i18next runtime execution.
findings.fix: Set count semantics for n and explicit locale-aware measurement formatting for lag/r/a/b; preserve null markers, signed seconds and normalized dimensionless values without changing chart data.
